candidate_query:
MATCH (hub:Spec {specNumber: '38.413'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
MATCH (edition:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
MATCH (anchor:Section {sectionNumber: '9.3.1'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(edition)
MATCH (anchor)-[:HAS_SUB_SECTION]->(obj:Section)
RETURN DISTINCT obj.sectionId AS sectionId, obj.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber, obj.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle
ORDER BY sectionId

MATCH (hub:Spec {specNumber: '38.413'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
MATCH (edition:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
MATCH (anchor:Section {sectionNumber: '8.7.5.2'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(edition)
MATCH (anchor)-[:CONTAINS_FIGURE]->(obj:TSFigure)
RETURN DISTINCT obj.figureId AS figureId, obj.figureNumber AS figureNumber, obj.figureCaption AS figureCaption
ORDER BY figureId
